html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Meet the girl who is traveling with her Half-Moon Bear Spirit
and the noble monk of Kamar-Taj through this patch.

 

Tier-4 and new Uniforms have been added to
Cresent who is training martial arts with the Half-Moon Bear Io
and Ancient One who is dedicated to peace as the Sorcerer Supreme.

 

Agents, check out the new skills and power of the updated hero
by downloading the 4/1 Patch!

 

■ 4/1 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 4/2 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 4/1 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[4/2 (Tue) 3:01 (UTC+0), 4/1 (Mon) 20:01 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 4/2 (Tue) 2:59 (UTC+0), 4/1 (Mon) 19:59 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.


▣ Two New Uniform

 

Two new Uniforms Ancient One <The Monk of Kamar-Taj> and Crescent <B-Girl Crew> have been added.

* The two new Uniforms can be purchased after the 4/1 Patch data has been applied.
* The new Uniforms can be purchased during the event period.
* Seasonal Uniforms may be sold again through similar events and packages after the event has ended.


▶ Crescent <B-Girl Crew>: 
After the entire 4/1 Patch and events have been applied - 4/18 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the entire 4/1 Patch and events have been applied - 4/18 (Fri) 7:59 (PDT)
- Purchase Method: Exchange through the event shop with Mischief Tokens.
- Mischief Tokens can be acquired by purchasing event-related products 
until 4/15 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0), 4/15 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT).
* Mischief Tokens can be acquired from some Web Shop products.
Please check the details before purchasing.

▶ Two April Fools' Day Web Shop products will be added.

Purchase schedule:

After the 4/1 Patch - 4/15 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 4/1 Patch - 4/15 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

Visit the Web Shop during the event!

[Go to the Web Shop]


▶ Ancient One <The Monk of Kamar-Taj>: 
After the entire 4/1 Patch and events have been applied - 4/15 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the entire 4/1 Patch and events have been applied - 4/15 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Purchase Method: Crystals (Discounts will not be applied.)

 

* The skill effects of the Uniform are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

▣ Crescent, Ancient One Tier-4

Tier 4 Advancement has been added to the two Super Heroes.
This power will help Crescent's journey and Ancient One's role as a leader.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 


We look forward to your active participation in the events 

that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
